coverageNotes: Recognizes the documented Convex boundary under supplied conditions. Does not establish independent implementation skill or all source requirements.

questions.concept: Mutation scheduling commits atomically with database writes
questions.question: After initiate is called with fail: true and throws, what remains from that call?

options.text: A pending row and a scheduled POST.
options.rationale: The uncaught mutation error rolls back both the write and the scheduling operation.

options.text: Neither a request row nor a scheduled POST.
options.rationale: Mutation writes and scheduling are committed together; neither survives the error.

options.text: A pending row, but no scheduled POST.
options.rationale: The database insert also rolls back; it is not an earlier independent commit.

options.text: A scheduled POST, but no request row.
options.rationale: runAfter in a mutation does not dispatch independently before that mutation commits.
